description: This PHP source file manages custom field mappings for the Leads module in vtiger CRM, including functions to retrieve and process custom field data and generate mappings for different modules.

methods.name: customFieldMappings
methods.description: Retrieves and constructs an array of custom field mappings for the Leads module, including related module values.

methods.name: getModuleValues
methods.description: Fetches module-specific fields and their attributes, used in mapping custom fields.
